purpose: Restore only original two LES table metadata rows and one field-to-data-source relationship;no business records.

preflight.tables: Each case-insensitive ID absent or exactly one row with source ID,AUDITABLE0,ATTACHMENT0.
preflight.hierarchy: No child relationship or exactly one source child/master/refer tuple;preserve actual generated ID;reject duplicate/case/conflicting tuple.
preflight.order: Check all three before INSERT;equivalent rows skip;no UPDATE/DELETE.
preflight.session: Dedicated CURRENT_SCHEMA=LIMS_RUNTIME_LOCAL;SESSION_USER SYS or local owner;root verifies actual Docker instance.

transaction: Metadata DML uses savepoint and rollback on failure;commit only after all INSERTs. Sequence allocation is not transaction rollback. No DDL.
limitations: Prepared only;root owns application and cleanup coordination.
No baseline or runtime policy changes,cache mutation,business rows or strict promotion.
No concurrency lock against other metadata administrators;execute idle.
source_contract: CoreTableServiceImpl.selectTable and hierarchy traversal require these original metadata rows before cascade business acceptance.
